# Autonomek (ES / EN)

> B2B AI Engineering, Process Automation & High-Performance Web Development firm serving enterprises in the United States, Spain, Mexico, and Colombia. We transform high-friction communication channels (WhatsApp, Web, CRM, ERP, Spreadsheets) into autonomous client acquisition and operational systems.
>
> Firma de ingeniería de software B2B, automatización de procesos operativos y comerciales, y agentes de Inteligencia Artificial para empresas en España, México, Colombia y Estados Unidos.
